text:
maria: quick question — trying to make an env var optional in our chart depending on whether an ExternalSecret created by terraform exists. I don't want the pod to crash if the secret is missing. currently using envFrom with secretRef but not sure if helm should render that block or rely on k8s optional. any recommended pattern?

ashok: we usually prefer letting k8s handle missing secrets with optional: true on the secretRef under envFrom. keeps the chart simple and avoids helm doing lookups at render time. e.g.

```yaml
envFrom:
  - secretRef:
      name: {{ .Values.externalSecret.name }}
      optional: true
```

ryan: +1 to optional:true. if you need to omit the whole env var (not just empty), you can do a lookup in the template and gate the env/ envFrom block. example:

```gotemplate
{{- $s := lookup "v1" "Secret" .Release.Namespace .Values.externalSecret.name }}
{{- if $s }}
envFrom:
  - secretRef:
      name: {{ .Values.externalSecret.name }}
{{- end }}
```

maria: good — thanks. one wrinkle: terraform provisions ExternalSecret CR (external-secrets.io) which then creates the k8s Secret asynchronously. is it safe to rely on optional:true in that flow? i.e., chart deploy may run before external-secrets controller syncs.

ashok: optional:true is safe — pod will start without the keys. but if your app needs the secret to function, you'll want a rolling restart or readiness gating once the Secret is present. we do an init-container check in a few services:

```bash
# simplistic check, run in init container
if [ -z "$(kubectl get secret $SECRET -n $NAMESPACE -o jsonpath='{.data.api_key}' 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
  echo 'secret not found yet, exit non-zero to retry'
  exit 1
fi
```

ryan: another pattern: chart can expose a value `waitForSecret: true` that toggles a helper hook or init container. keeps helm simple but gives option to block until secret present.

sara: fwiw i just merged a terraform change that names the ExternalSecret to `{{ env "SERVICE" }}-external` so set chart value to match. terraform PR: https://git.internal/r/infra/terraform/pulls/312 (link) :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: helm lint + unit tests passed on feature/secret-optional-check (CI #4521) :white_check_mark:

maria: cool. i'll add `optional: true` by default and a `waitForSecret` flag for services that must block. i'll open a small PR to eng-platform chart and reference the terraform PR. thanks! :raised_hands:
